evidence.text: Relic: The Last Light - Imperial; Availability: Near-Unique; Effect: Lasgun: 1d10 radiant; 100/300 ft; Accurate, Armour-Breaking, Reload 30. Once per short rest on a hit, choose a second creature directly behind the target within 30 ft; if the original attack roll would hit it, it takes 1d10 radiant damage.
